notesStmt.note: The poem "Paumanok" was first published in the New York Herald on February 29, 1888. This manuscript therefore dates from some time before then, most likely 1887 or early 1888.

This is a manuscript draft of the poem "Paumanok," which was first published in the New York Herald on February 29, 1888. It was then included in November Boughs (1888), as well as the "Sands at Seventy" annex to the final edition of Leaves of Grass (1891–92).

On the verso of this manuscript is a letter from Robert Pearsall Smith to Walt Whitman, dated 13 February 1888.

lg.head: Paumanok.
lg.l:
One side thy inland ocean ‸laving, shelter'd
copiousbroad, with copious commerce, steamers sails,

And one the Atlantic's saltwind caressesing

a mighty hull

distance
